Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text-based ATC clauses For each item, bidders must upload OEM authorization on OEM letterhead quoting the current bid number to participate.

Bidders must upload OEM warranty certificates on OEM letterhead, stating the warranty period for each qu oted make, wherever applicable. Bidders must upload the M.I.I. certificate from the OEMs (wherever applicable) of the quoted makes, clearly indicating the class and percentage of local content, as required by Government Public Procuremen t (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017, subsequent orders dated 04.06.2020 and 16.09.2020, and clari fication dated 04.03.2021. Bidders are required to upload past performance and experience documents for primary category items, i n the form of GeM contract orders and corresponding CRACs, covering the previous three years. Bidders must upload their annual turnover for the last three consecutive financial years, duly verified by a Chartered Accountant. It is mandatory to include the CA's UDIN number on the CA letterhead. The bidder is required to upload the annual turnover details of the OEM(s) for the last three consecutive fin ancial years for all specified makes quoted in this bid. Bidders must upload valid technical specifications and test certificates for each quoted item when bidding. The bidder must upload GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B certificates for the last three months along with the bid. The bidder must upload a financial standing certificate on their letterhead at the time of bidding, the firm must provide a duly signed statement confirming that it is not under liquidation, court receivership, bankru ptcy, or any similar proceedings. Additionally, the bidder must declare that their firm has not been suspen ded, delisted, or blacklisted by any organization for any reason. The bidder must upload the scope of supply, clearly stating the Bid Number and Date, as well as the Make, Model Number, and MRP for each item quoted. The sellers will upload a notarized declaration on stamp paper of Rs. 10/- that t he firm has not been blacklisted for business by any government /PSU organizat ion. The date of the notary should be within 3 months of the bid publication dat e failing which bid will be rejected. Acceptable brands include HAVELLS, LEGRAND, CROMPTON, ANCHOR, SURYA, HAGER, ORIENT, INDOASIA N PLAZA and KINJAL only. .
